executiveSummary: Multiple government advisories confirm active targeting of OT environments and critical edge systems. Iranian-affiliated actors are modifying logic on internet-exposed PLCs across the Water and Wastewater Systems sector and other CI, causing operational impacts; immediate removal of PLCs from public internet and hardening of remote access are required. Security Advisory A JPCERT/CC notice highlights widespread leakage and ongoing misuse of FortiGate credentials (“FortiBleed”), including evidence of VPN logins and potential AD credential theft via edge-to-identity paths—rotate keys, enforce MFA, and upgrade FortiOS password hashing. Security Advisory CISA released an ICS advisory for Toptech Systems RCU II+ and Multiload II+ petroleum terminal controllers exposing an unauthenticated debug service granting root access; deploy vendor VRT/firmware and immediately segment these controllers. Security Advisory Mitsubishi Electric’s CC-Link IE TSN protocol implementation permits control-data tampering/DoS across many MELSEC/servo/HMI/robot families; no fix is planned—operators must enforce strict zoning, filtering, and anomaly monitoring on CC‑Link IE TSN networks. Security Advisory Multiple actively exploited edge and collaboration products elevate enterprise-to-OT pivot risk, including F5 BIG‑IP APM unauth RCE, Ivanti EPMM RCE, Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center KEV, Check Point VPN auth bypass, and Zimbra zero‑day abuse by Russian state actors. Patch immediately, restrict management exposure, and hunt for indicators. Security Advisory Security Advisory KEV Update Security Advisory Supporting Report Nation-state campaigns abusing SOHO/IoT device botnets (China‑nexus) and covert router exploitation by Russia’s FSB Center 16 increase stealth entry and persistence in CI networks; urgently harden edge infrastructure and replace EoL devices. Security Advisory Security Advisory

topThreats.title: 1) Iranian-affiliated PLC intrusions (multi-sector)
topThreats.action: Active manipulation of PLC logic and HMI data in WWS/Energy with loss-of-view and operational impacts. Immediate isolation and credential hardening required. Security Advisory

topThreats.title: 2) FortiGate “FortiBleed” credential leakage
topThreats.action: Leaked configs and valid logins enable perimeter bypass and AD credential theft via edge trust paths; rotate secrets, enforce MFA, and upgrade hashing. Security Advisory

topThreats.title: 3) Petroleum terminal controllers (Toptech)
topThreats.action: Unauthenticated debug service grants root on RCU II+/Multiload II+; deploy vendor VRT/firmware and segment devices immediately. Security Advisory

topThreats.title: 4) CC‑Link IE TSN protocol tampering
topThreats.action: Widespread Mitsubishi Electric devices vulnerable to I/O manipulation/DoS with no fix; enforce IEC 62443 zoning and industrial firewalls. Security Advisory

descriptions: Initial access: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190); Valid Accounts (T1078) via leaked credentials/VPN abuse; Supply Chain Compromise (T1195)
Execution/Defense Evasion: Command and Scripting Interpreter (T1059); DLL search-order hijacking; OAuth abuse; schedule tasks/services for persistence
Credential Access: OS credential dumping; browser/email token theft; app-specific password creation
Discovery/Lateral Movement: Network scanning (Fscan); PsExec/PAExec; RDP/SSH; reverse SSH SOCKS tunnels; WebSocket covert tunnels
Collection/Exfiltration: C2 via Microsoft Graph calendar, DNS AAAA config recovery; DNS/HTTPS beacons; data staging on webmail/OneDrive
Impact (ICS): Loss of View/Control; PLC logic modification; ESXi VM shutdown/encryption; protocol-level I/O tampering

outlook72h: Execute emergency patch windows for F5 BIG‑IP APM, Ivanti EPMM, Cisco FMC, Check Point VPN; restrict public exposure immediately. Inventory and disconnect any internet‑reachable PLCs/engineering workstations; enforce VPN+MFA and IP allowlists for remote operations. FortiGate estates: rotate all credentials, revoke tokens, audit config exports and admin/API access logs; upgrade hashing and firmware. Apply Toptech VRT/firmware and immediately segment petroleum terminal controllers; validate operational safety checks post‑maintenance. Patch Zimbra/Exchange/SharePoint/ADFS; revoke session tokens; hunt for app passwords and webmail implants; tune detections for SOAP/API anomalies. Harden mail and identity per KEV/BOD due dates; run targeted hunts for known IoCs across DNS/Proxy/EDR.
